[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 180
- Description: Fix: derived signal flags wiped on EODHD price reimport (sentiment_importer) + prod deploy
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sentiment_importer/pull/1136
  
  Details:
  Root-caused and fixed a silent data-loss bug in sentiment_importer, then deployed it to production.
  
  PROBLEM
  `rake eodhd:reimport_company[SYMBOL]` (used to repair split-adjusted prices) deletes and reloads a company's DailyTrade rows. Its final `find_each { dt.save! }` pass fires only `before_save` callbacks, so the derived signal flags set by the DOWNSTREAM cascade — `large_dip` (universe-wide raw SQL), `first_dip` (LargeDipperIsFirst worker), `buy_now`/`sell_now` (require a prior `first_dip`), `recovered` (LargeDipRecovered) — were never recomputed and ended up wiped. Any symbol reimported for a split silently lost its signals.
  
  FIX (merged to master)
  1. sentiment_importer PR #1136 (squash-merged @ 2026-09-17T13:26:23Z):
     - NEW `app/models/daily_trade_signal_rebuilder.rb` — `DailyTradeSignalRebuilder.rebuild!(company_id)`: a COMPANY-SCOPED re-run of the pipeline cascade (Phase A reset -> B large_dip -> C first_dip + save! buy/sell + SMAs -> D recovered). Scoped so it never re-enqueues universe-wide jobs.
     - EDITED `lib/tasks/backfill_eod_data.rake` — `reimport_company` now calls the rebuilder as its final step; added `rake eodhd:rebuild_signals[SYMBOL]` escape hatch.
  2. Verified the repair live on LRCX (company_id 1940) earlier in this thread — restored large_dip=132, first_dip=51, buy_now=50, sell_now=50 and all SMAs.
  
  DEPLOY
  Deployed via `./deploy.sh --skip-migrate` (no schema change) to seni_ror (NELANCO 54.211.179.126) + seni_sk_nelanco (sidekiq).
  Note: the deploy had to be run as a transient systemd unit (`systemd-run --property=User=ubuntu`) because a plain detached process was killed when the SSH session closed; also had to seed known_hosts for the unit context.
  VERIFIED LIVE on seni_ror:
  - HEAD = 9dc2c95a "Rebuild derived signal flags after price reimport (#1136)"
  - app/models/daily_trade_signal_rebuilder.rb present
  - `rake -T` lists `eodhd:rebuild_signals[stock_symbol]`
  - seni_ror active (restarted 2026-09-17 13:52:46 UTC), port 3002 up
  - seni_sk sidekiq active
  - deploy.sh reported "deploy complete", EXIT=0
  
  IMPACT
  LRCX's signals are correct in prod; PR #1136 ensures no future reimport silently wipes any symbol's signals.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 300.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
